description: Land Acquisition - Deevilla Vilage, Yatawatha D/S Division, Matara District - Correction Notice Amending Sinhala Notice of 2204/9 dated 01.12.2020
reasoning: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire a particular plot of land (Dangan Watte, 0.3062 hectares) for building quarters for the Divisional Secretary and Assistant Divisional Secretary. The content focuses entirely on land acquisition procedures, property description, and compensation claims, making it clearly a land-related matter that falls under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
